note: Both sets capture the core datum and scale facts (grade level 0'-0", finished floor 2'-9 1/2", and the 3/8" = 1'-0" scales for sections C1 and A1) with supporting quotes. Set B additionally extracts the revision table entries (marks 1-5 with dates and descriptions), the project name, and the lot number, all of which are clearly supported by the text layer and title block. Set A omits these important title-block and revision facts and instead repeats the grade level and finished floor values several times in near-identical claims, adding no new information. Neither set contains a clearly misread or invented value, so B wins on coverage and faithfulness.
